stages.name: TAL Criteria Definition
stages.objective: Define characteristics of ideal target accounts
stages.input: Customer profiles, revenue data, market research, product fit data
stages.output: Documented TAL criteria with scoring methodology
stages.activities: Define company size criteria, define industry/vertical criteria, define growth criteria, define budget/spend criteria, define technographic criteria, weight criteria by importance
stages.roles: Sales leadership (criteria), Marketing (market data), Product (fit assessment)
stages.successMetric: TAL criteria documented with 8-12 weighted factors
stages.decisionPoints: Criteria comprehensive? Weighted appropriately? Data available?
stages.qualityGate: TAL criteria approved by leadership, scoring model built

stages.name: Account Data Sourcing
stages.objective: Gather data on potential target accounts
stages.input: TAL criteria, market data sources, customer data
stages.output: Database of accounts with required attributes
stages.activities: Source account list from data providers, pull company data, gather technology data, pull funding/growth data, validate data quality
stages.tools: Data providers (Apollo, Prospeo), business databases, technology trackers
stages.successMetric: Account database with 5000+ accounts and required attributes
stages.decisionPoints: Account list comprehensive? Data quality acceptable? Duplicates removed? Relevant geographically?

stages.name: Account Scoring & Ranking
stages.objective: Score all accounts against TAL criteria and rank by fit
stages.input: Account database, TAL criteria, scoring model
stages.output: Ranked account list with fit scores
stages.activities: Apply scoring model to all accounts, calculate composite scores, rank accounts, identify tiers (high/medium/low), validate sample manually
stages.successMetric: All accounts scored and ranked, 500+ high-fit accounts identified
stages.decisionPoints: Scores accurate? Validation confirms quality? Tiers meaningful? Top accounts known?
stages.qualityGate: Scoring complete, top 500 accounts identified and validated

stages.name: Account Qualification
stages.objective: Deeply qualify top accounts and assess enterprise potential
stages.input: Ranked account list, top accounts
stages.output: Qualified account list with opportunity assessment
stages.activities: Research top accounts, identify decision-makers, assess buying patterns, evaluate fit with sales process, identify red flags
stages.tools: Sales research tools, LinkedIn, news sources
stages.decisionPoints: Truly target accounts? Decision-maker identifiable? Budget expected? Buying timeline?

stages.name: TAL Prioritization & Segmentation
stages.objective: Prioritize TAL and create go-to-market segments
stages.input: Qualified account list, revenue potential, strategic fit
stages.output: Segmented TAL with 3-4 priority tiers and segments
stages.activities: Prioritize by revenue potential, segment by industry/size/geography, identify strategic accounts, create segment-specific strategies
stages.successMetric: TAL segmented with Tier 1 (50 accounts), Tier 2 (200), Tier 3 (500)
stages.decisionPoints: Right number in each tier? Segments meaningful? Strategy clear?
stages.qualityGate: TAL finalized and segmented, go-to-market strategy ready

stages.name: Account Assignment & Team Allocation
stages.objective: Assign accounts to sales team members and plan resource allocation
stages.input: Segmented TAL, sales team, account characteristics
stages.output: Account assignment plan with owner and resource allocation
stages.activities: Assign Tier 1 accounts to enterprise AEs, assign Tier 2 to SDRs for routing, assign Tier 3 to automated outreach, allocate support resources, plan enablement
stages.successMetric: 100% of accounts assigned with clear ownership
stages.decisionPoints: Right account owner? Capacity matched? Coverage complete?
stages.qualityGate: Assignments finalized, owners briefed, resources allocated

stages.name: Comprehensive Company Research
stages.objective: Gather company-level intelligence on target account
stages.input: Account data, research sources
stages.output: Company profile with overview and opportunity assessment
stages.activities: Research company background, assess growth trajectory, identify revenue sources, research competitors, research strategy/direction, assess leadership
stages.tools: News aggregators, LinkedIn, company websites, industry reports
stages.decisionPoints: Key info gathered? Company direction clear? Competitive position understood? Growth trajectory identifiable?
stages.qualityGate: Company profile complete, shared with sales team

stages.name: Organizational Structure & Stakeholder Mapping
stages.objective: Map customer organization and identify all stakeholders
stages.input: Company profile, organizational data, LinkedIn data
stages.activities: Map organizational structure, identify C-suite, identify relevant department heads, identify budget owners, identify influencers/blockers
stages.tools: Org mapping tools, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
stages.decisionPoints: Structure clear? Budget owner identified? Coach/champion identified? Blockers identified?
stages.qualityGate: Org chart validated, stakeholder roles understood

stages.name: Problem & Pain Point Analysis
stages.objective: Identify company's business challenges and pain points
stages.input: Company research, industry analysis, press releases, job postings
stages.output: Pain point summary with relevance to product
stages.activities: Analyze company financials for challenges, review industry trends affecting company, research news for strategic challenges, identify hiring patterns indicating growth areas, assess competitive threats
stages.tools: Financial research, news tracking, job board analysis
stages.successMetric: 3-5 key pain points identified and linked to product solution
stages.decisionPoints: Pain points real? Company actively addressing? Solution relevant? Urgency?
stages.qualityGate: Pain point analysis complete and validated

stages.name: Buying Process Understanding
stages.objective: Understand how account evaluates and purchases solutions
stages.input: Company research, comparable accounts, sales history
stages.output: Buying process summary with decision criteria
stages.activities: Analyze comparable accounts for buying patterns, research decision criteria from industry/analyst reports, assess approval complexity, identify budget cycle
stages.decisionPoints: Buying process clear? Timeline understood? Budget cycle identified? Approval levels?

stages.name: Technology Stack & System Assessment
stages.objective: Understand account's current technology and integration needs
stages.input: Company research, technology tracking data
stages.activities: Identify current systems using technology trackers, assess current solutions for replacement opportunity, identify integration points, assess technology maturity
stages.successMetric: Technology stack documented with integration points
stages.decisionPoints: Current solution adequate? Replacement opportunity? Integration needed? Timeline for change?
stages.qualityGate: Technology stack mapped, integration strategy identified

stages.name: Incumbent & Competitor Identification
stages.objective: Identify current solutions and competitors at target account
stages.input: Account research, company data, technology tracking
stages.activities: Research current solutions using technology trackers, identify incumbent vendors, assess competitive threats, document version/implementation details
stages.successMetric: Current solutions identified for target account
stages.decisionPoints: Incumbents clear? Switching likelihood? Competitive threat?

stages.name: Win/Loss Pattern Analysis
stages.objective: Understand competitive win/loss patterns at this account type
stages.input: Historical win/loss data, account industry/size
stages.activities: Analyze historical wins vs. competitors, identify competitive patterns, assess pricing impact, identify typical objections, document competitive strengths/weaknesses
stages.decisionPoints: Patterns clear? Competitive threats identified?

stages.name: Pricing & Offer Comparison
stages.objective: Assess competitive pricing and offers
stages.input: Competitor pricing intelligence, deal economics
stages.activities: Research competitor pricing, assess value positioning, identify price differentiators, model win probability at different prices
stages.decisionPoints: Pricing competitive? Value justifiable? Discount strategy?

stages.name: Feature/Capability Comparison
stages.objective: Compare product capabilities vs. competitors
stages.input: Product roadmap, competitor products
stages.activities: Document competitor features, compare against product, identify gaps/advantages, assess importance to account, plan messaging
stages.decisionPoints: Differentiation clear? Gaps acceptable? Advantages clear?

stages.name: Objection Handling Strategy
stages.objective: Prepare responses to anticipated competitive objections
stages.input: Competitive analysis, common objections, positioning strategy
stages.output: Objection handling playbook for this account
stages.activities: Identify likely objections, develop responses, identify proof points, prepare ROI comparisons, document competitive neutralizers
stages.decisionPoints: Responses credible? Proof points available? ROI clear?
stages.qualityGate: Objection handling guide ready for sales

stages.name: Current Revenue & Usage Analysis
stages.objective: Understand current account revenue and expansion potential
stages.input: Customer data, usage patterns, contract terms
stages.output: Current state analysis with expansion potential
stages.activities: Analyze current ACV/MRR, assess usage by department, identify power users, quantify unutilized features, project growth trajectory
stages.decisionPoints: Expansion potential clear? Utilization levels? Growth trajectory?

stages.name: Expansion Type Identification
stages.objective: Identify types of expansion opportunities
stages.input: Current state analysis, product capabilities, customer organization
stages.activities: Identify horizontal expansion (other departments), identify vertical expansion (other geographies), identify product expansion (add-ons/upgrades), identify deeper penetration
stages.decisionPoints: Opportunities realistic? Customer interest likely? ROI positive?

stages.name: Opportunity Sizing & ROI
stages.objective: Size expansion opportunities and calculate potential ROI
stages.input: Expansion opportunities, pricing, customer financials
stages.activities: Estimate number of additional users/seats, calculate incremental revenue, model implementation costs, calculate ROI/payback, rank by impact
stages.decisionPoints: Sizing realistic? ROI compelling? Payback acceptable?

stages.name: Go/No-Go Decision
stages.objective: Decide which expansion opportunities to pursue
stages.input: Sized opportunities, ROI analysis, resource availability
stages.activities: Prioritize opportunities by ROI and timeline, assess customer readiness, identify resource requirements, make go/no-go decision, plan next steps
stages.decisionPoints: Opportunities worth pursuing? Timing right? Resources available?

stages.name: Target Department Analysis
stages.objective: Analyze target department for expansion
stages.input: Company structure, department data, usage analysis
stages.output: Target department profile with expansion potential
stages.activities: Identify department needs and pain points, assess headcount, analyze current process, identify key stakeholders, assess adoption likelihood
stages.decisionPoints: Needs clear? Pain points addressable? Adoption likely?

stages.name: Use Case Development
stages.objective: Develop compelling use case for target department
stages.input: Department analysis, product capabilities, department needs
stages.output: Use case document with business justification
stages.activities: Define business problem for department, map product solution, quantify impact specific to department, identify measurable success criteria
stages.decisionPoints: Use case compelling? Relevant to department needs?

stages.name: Business Case Development
stages.objective: Develop financial business case for department expansion
stages.input: Use case, department sizing, ROI model
stages.activities: Quantify department impact, calculate ROI for department, identify implementation costs, calculate payback, compare to alternatives
stages.decisionPoints: ROI compelling? Payback acceptable? Presentation ready?

stages.name: Department Stakeholder Identification & Mapping
stages.objective: Identify and map all stakeholders in target department
stages.input: Department profile, organizational structure
stages.activities: Identify department head, identify budget owner, identify influencers/power users, identify potential objectors, develop influence strategy
stages.decisionPoints: Right stakeholders identified? Power structure clear?

stages.name: Pilot Program Design & Execution
stages.objective: Plan and execute pilot with target department
stages.input: Business case, stakeholder map, pilot structure
stages.activities: Define pilot scope and success criteria, recruit pilot participants, provide training, monitor pilot closely, document results, celebrate early wins
stages.decisionPoints: Pilot successful? ROI realized? Department enthusiastic?
stages.qualityGate: Pilot results documented, expansion decision clear

stages.name: Full Department Expansion & Implementation
stages.objective: Roll out to full department
stages.input: Pilot results, expansion plan, resource plan
stages.activities: Expand to full department user base, provide comprehensive training, manage implementation, monitor adoption, adjust based on feedback
stages.successMetric: Full department adoption with usage similar to pilot
stages.decisionPoints: Adoption on track? Support adequate? Champion engaged?
stages.qualityGate: Full expansion complete, success metrics tracked

stages.name: Feature/Module Expansion Analysis
stages.objective: Identify add-on products or modules for expansion
stages.input: Product roadmap, customer usage data, expansion strategy
stages.output: List of expansion candidates by customer
stages.activities: Analyze current feature adoption, identify underadopted features, identify complementary products, assess expansion fit for account type
stages.decisionPoints: Candidates align to customer strategy? Value clear?

stages.name: Adoption & Readiness Assessment
stages.objective: Assess customer readiness for expansion
stages.input: Customer health, current adoption, organization readiness
stages.activities: Assess current product adoption depth, analyze training readiness, evaluate budget availability, assess organizational bandwidth
stages.decisionPoints: Customer ready now or later? Barriers to adoption?

stages.name: Pricing & Bundling Strategy
stages.objective: Develop pricing and packaging for add-on expansion
stages.input: Add-on product, customer metrics, pricing models
stages.output: Pricing and bundling strategy for this customer
stages.activities: Develop pricing options (standalone, bundled, tiered), model revenue impact, assess willingness to pay, prepare pricing justification
stages.decisionPoints: Pricing competitive? Value justified?

stages.name: Business Justification & Proposal
stages.objective: Develop compelling business case and proposal
stages.input: Add-on product, pricing, customer value
stages.activities: Develop customer-specific ROI, create proposal, prepare presentation, identify success criteria
stages.decisionPoints: Proposal compelling? Customized to customer?

stages.name: Sales Team Training & Enablement
stages.objective: Train sales team on new add-on product
stages.input: Product details, customer use cases, pricing
stages.output: Trained sales team ready to sell
stages.activities: Product training on features/benefits, training on customer use cases, pricing training, competitive positioning, objection handling
stages.decisionPoints: Team confident? Can articulate value?

stages.name: Customer Launch & Promotion
stages.objective: Launch add-on to customer with promotional support
stages.input: Proposal, pricing, customer contacts
stages.activities: Present to customer, drive adoption, provide training, monitor usage, celebrate success
stages.decisionPoints: Customer purchased? Usage adopted? Satisfaction high?

stages.name: Opportunity Discovery
stages.objective: Discover and qualify expansion opportunity
stages.input: Expansion opportunities identified, customer interest
stages.activities: Conduct discovery meeting, understand business drivers, assess budget, identify timeline, evaluate priority
stages.decisionPoints: Real opportunity? Budget available? Timeline realistic?

stages.name: Needs Analysis & Assessment
stages.objective: Deeply understand customer needs for expansion
stages.input: Opportunity, customer business context
stages.activities: Conduct detailed needs analysis, map requirements to product capabilities, identify success criteria, identify constraints/concerns
stages.decisionPoints: Requirements clear? Product fit? Any gaps?

stages.name: Solution Design & Demo
stages.objective: Design solution and demonstrate to customer
stages.input: Needs assessment, product capabilities, pricing
stages.activities: Design solution for customer's specific needs, prepare demo, conduct live demo, gather feedback, iterate design
stages.decisionPoints: Solution addresses needs? Customer interested? Questions addressed?

stages.name: Proposal & Negotiation
stages.objective: Present proposal and negotiate terms
stages.input: Solution design, pricing, customer requirements
stages.activities: Present formal proposal, discuss pricing, address objections, negotiate terms, finalize economics
stages.decisionPoints: Customer accepting? Pricing acceptable? Timeline confirmed?

stages.name: Contract & Implementation Planning
stages.objective: Execute contract and plan implementation
stages.input: Agreed proposal, implementation requirements
stages.activities: Prepare contract, execute signature, develop implementation plan, identify implementation owner, schedule kickoff
stages.decisionPoints: Contract clear? Implementation timeline realistic?

stages.name: Successful Adoption & Value Realization
stages.objective: Ensure successful adoption and value realization
stages.input: Implementation plan, success metrics
stages.activities: Execute implementation, provide training, monitor adoption, support challenges, measure value realization
stages.decisionPoints: Adoption on track? Value realized? Customer happy?

stages.name: Land Strategy Development
stages.objective: Develop land strategy to enter account at scale
stages.input: Land ICP, market sizing, go-to-market strategy
stages.activities: Define landing product/solution, identify target buyer persona, define landing price point, outline success criteria for land phase
stages.decisionPoints: Landing product right? Target persona clear? Price point accessible?

stages.name: Expansion Opportunity Mapping
stages.objective: Map expansion opportunities for target accounts
stages.input: Land strategy, product portfolio, customer segments
stages.output: Expansion roadmap for typical land account
stages.activities: Map expansion opportunities by department, map expansion by geography, map expansion by use case, identify typical expansion sequence
stages.decisionPoints: Expansion opportunities realistic? Sequence make sense? Timing clear?

stages.name: Expansion Trigger Definition
stages.objective: Define signals/metrics triggering expansion conversations
stages.input: Customer lifecycle, expansion opportunities, timing
stages.activities: Define usage triggers (adoption levels), define business triggers (growth indicators), define timeline triggers (post-implementation), create trigger monitoring process
stages.decisionPoints: Triggers predictive? Monitoring automated? Response process clear?

stages.name: Expansion Acceleration Tactics
stages.objective: Develop tactics to accelerate expansion
stages.input: Expansion roadmap, customer success plan
stages.activities: Develop training on new features, plan user group events, create expansion-focused communications, identify expansion champions, plan executive engagement
stages.decisionPoints: Tactics compelling? Resource available? Timeline realistic?

stages.name: Expansion Execution & Monitoring
stages.objective: Execute expansion and monitor success
stages.input: Expansion triggers, expansion tactics
stages.activities: Monitor expansion triggers, execute expansion conversations when triggered, measure expansion success, iterate based on results
stages.decisionPoints: Expansion timing right? Conversion rates acceptable? Customer satisfaction?

stages.name: High-Value Account Prioritization
stages.objective: Identify and prioritize key accounts for ABM investment
stages.input: Account list, revenue potential, strategic fit
stages.output: ABM target account list with prioritization
stages.activities: Score accounts by revenue potential, score by strategic fit, identify must-win accounts, segment into tier levels
stages.successMetric: ABM account list with 50-200 accounts prioritized
stages.decisionPoints: Right mix of accounts? Tier distribution appropriate?

stages.name: Account-Specific Strategy Development
stages.objective: Develop customized strategy for each ABM account
stages.input: Account research, company strategy, competitive positioning
stages.activities: Research account goals/challenges, develop value hypothesis, identify key stakeholders, plan stakeholder-specific messaging
stages.successMetric: Strategy developed for all ABM accounts
stages.decisionPoints: Strategy realistic? Stakeholder-specific? Value clear?

stages.name: Personalized Content & Messaging Development
stages.objective: Create account-specific content and messaging
stages.input: Account strategy, company position, content assets
stages.output: Personalized content package for each account
stages.activities: Develop account-specific case studies, create stakeholder-specific messaging, personalize ads/emails, develop custom thought leadership
stages.successMetric: Personalized content created for all accounts
stages.decisionPoints: Content compelling? Stakeholder-relevant? Production feasible?

stages.name: Multi-Channel Campaign Execution
stages.objective: Execute coordinated multi-channel campaigns
stages.input: Personalized content, account strategy, channel mix
stages.activities: Deploy account-based advertising, send personalized emails, execute account events, coordinate sales outreach, orchestrate messaging
stages.successMetric: Multi-channel campaigns active for all accounts
stages.decisionPoints: Campaigns coordinated? Messaging consistent? Frequency appropriate?

stages.name: Engagement Tracking & Analytics
stages.objective: Track engagement and measure campaign effectiveness
stages.input: Campaign data, engagement metrics
stages.activities: Track engagement by channel, measure account-level response rates, analyze decision-maker engagement, calculate ABM ROI
stages.successMetric: Engagement tracked for all ABM accounts with ROI calculated
stages.decisionPoints: Engagement rates healthy? ROI positive? Insights actionable?

stages.name: Continuous Optimization & Results
stages.objective: Optimize campaigns based on performance
stages.input: Engagement data, results, team feedback
stages.activities: Analyze underperforming accounts, adjust messaging/tactics, test new approaches, celebrate wins, iterate based on learning
stages.successMetric: ABM pipeline increasing, win rates improving
stages.decisionPoints: Results improving? Tactics resonating? ROI positive?

stages.name: Account Assignment & Territory Planning
stages.objective: Assign accounts to account executives and plan territories
stages.input: Account list, AE team, territory criteria
stages.activities: Assign accounts to AEs based on territory/specialization, balance account load, identify gaps, plan coverage for unassigned accounts
stages.successMetric: All strategic accounts assigned, territories balanced
stages.decisionPoints: Coverage complete? Load balanced? Specialization matched?

stages.name: AE Strategy Alignment
stages.objective: Align AE strategy with corporate strategy
stages.input: Corporate strategy, account strategy, AE team
stages.output: Aligned AE strategies and quarterly plans
stages.activities: Brief AE on corporate strategy, review account strategies, develop AE-specific approach, set team-level targets
stages.decisionPoints: Team understands strategy? Approach clear? Targets realistic?

stages.name: Opportunity Pipeline Planning
stages.objective: Plan opportunity pipeline for assigned accounts
stages.input: Account expansion opportunities, sales cycle, capacity
stages.activities: Identify realistic opportunities per account, set opportunity targets, plan discovery timing, forecast closure dates
stages.decisionPoints: Pipeline realistic? Targets achievable? Opportunities qualified?

stages.name: Regular Account Reviews & Coaching
stages.objective: Conduct regular reviews and coach AEs
stages.input: Opportunity pipeline, account results, team feedback
stages.output: Account reviews with coaching and adjustments
stages.activities: Conduct monthly account reviews, assess progress vs. targets, identify blocked deals, provide coaching, adjust strategy as needed
stages.decisionPoints: Progress on track? Coaching effective? Deals advancing?

stages.name: Forecast & Results Management
stages.objective: Manage forecasts and track results
stages.input: Opportunity pipeline, closed deals, forecast models
stages.activities: Manage monthly forecasts, track results vs. targets, analyze variances, adjust pipeline, celebrate wins
stages.decisionPoints: Forecast accuracy improving? Results on track?
stages.qualityGate: Forecasting and results tracking working well

stages.name: ABM Campaign Strategy
stages.objective: Define strategy for account-based marketing campaigns
stages.input: ABM account list, marketing objectives, budget
stages.output: Campaign strategy with goals and targets
stages.activities: Define campaign objectives, identify campaign themes, plan campaign timeline, set engagement targets, plan budget allocation
stages.decisionPoints: Strategy aligned to sales? Targets achievable? Timeline realistic?

stages.name: Account Segmentation & Personalization
stages.objective: Segment accounts and develop personalization approach
stages.input: ABM account list, campaign strategy
stages.activities: Segment accounts by industry/size/profile, develop segment-specific messaging, plan account-specific creative, design engagement sequence
stages.decisionPoints: Segmentation meaningful? Personalization feasible? Resources adequate?

stages.name: Creative Development & Asset Production
stages.objective: Develop creative assets for campaigns
stages.input: Campaign strategy, personalization requirements, creative themes
stages.output: Complete creative library ready for campaigns
stages.activities: Develop account-based ads, create personalized landing pages, develop email sequences, create account-specific case studies
stages.decisionPoints: Creative quality high? Personalization evident? On-brand?

stages.name: Multi-Channel Campaign Orchestration
stages.objective: Orchestrate campaigns across channels
stages.input: Creative assets, account list, channel mix
stages.activities: Deploy ads to target accounts, execute email sequences, create account-based content, coordinate sales outreach, manage timing across channels
stages.decisionPoints: Orchestration smooth? Messaging consistent? Frequency right?

stages.name: Performance Tracking & Measurement
stages.objective: Track campaign performance and ROI
stages.input: Campaign data, engagement metrics, pipeline impact
stages.activities: Track impressions/clicks/engagement by account, measure pipeline impact, calculate campaign ROI, analyze by segment
stages.successMetric: Dashboard live with key metrics tracked
stages.decisionPoints: ROI positive? Engagement rates healthy? Insights clear?

stages.name: Optimization & Results
stages.objective: Optimize campaigns and demonstrate results
stages.input: Performance data, engagement insights
stages.activities: Analyze underperforming segments, test messaging variations, adjust targeting, scale winning approaches, document learning
stages.decisionPoints: Results positive? Learning captured? Strategy evolving?

stages.name: Reference Customer Identification
stages.objective: Identify ideal reference customers
stages.input: Customer data, success metrics, account value
stages.activities: Identify highly satisfied customers, assess willingness to reference, profile reference customers (industry, company size, use case), segment for targeting
stages.decisionPoints: Customers truly happy? Believable referrals? Diverse profiles?

stages.name: Advocate Recruitment & Program Enrollment
stages.objective: Recruit customers into reference/advocate program
stages.input: Reference customer list, program benefits
stages.activities: Recruit advocates by highlighting benefits (thought leadership, exclusive events), create advocate agreements, secure executive commitment, establish escalation path
stages.decisionPoints: Advocates committed? Benefits attractive? Agreements clear?

stages.name: Reference Call Training & Preparation
stages.objective: Train advocates on effective reference call process
stages.input: Advocate list, reference call frameworks, messaging
stages.activities: Train on reference call formats, provide talking points, create reference call scripts, establish time commitments, test call process
stages.decisionPoints: Training comprehensive? Advocates confident? Process clear?

stages.name: Success Story & Case Study Development
stages.objective: Document advocate stories for marketing use
stages.input: Customer success stories, advocate context
stages.activities: Conduct customer interviews, document success stories, create case studies, develop video testimonials, get approval from customers
stages.successMetric: 3-5 case studies and customer stories documented
stages.decisionPoints: Stories compelling? Approval secured? Assets sharable?

stages.name: Reference Call Coordination & Execution
stages.objective: Coordinate and execute reference calls with prospects
stages.input: Reference requests, advocate list
stages.output: Completed reference calls with prospect feedback
stages.activities: Match reference with prospect needs, schedule calls, prepare both parties, debrief after calls, document feedback
stages.decisionPoints: Calls valuable to prospects? Advocates engaged? Outcomes tracked?

stages.name: Advocate Recognition & Program Growth
stages.objective: Recognize advocates and grow program
stages.input: Call participation, advocate engagement data
stages.activities: Recognize active advocates, share customer stories internally, highlight advocates in communications, plan exclusive advocate events
stages.decisionPoints: Recognition meaningful? Program growing? Advocacy sustainable?
